requirements.requirement: Default a newly approved active Driver account to available for dispatch and preserve the choice of existing drivers.
requirements.scope: Staff activation and existing driver preference
requirements.uiReference: Invite driver, Approval Centre and Drivers directory
requirements.dataSource: The approved Driver role on users, its branch and request; users.driver_available.
requirements.securityControl: Initialise only on an authorised role transition to Driver. Do not grant early dispatch access or bypass staff approval.
negativeTests: A single approval does not open dispatch availability.
requirements.reason: Local service regression verified both independent approvals, the initial audit record and preservation of an existing opt-out.
requirements.testResult: PASS: invitation, pending role, final activation and existing choice.
requirements.outstandingWork: Deploy and verify onboarding in the hosted demo.

requirements.requirement: Let authorised staff change dispatch availability from the Drivers directory and explain where drivers change their own preference.
requirements.scope: Web driver directory and shared backend used by driver workspaces
requirements.uiReference: Delivery & Services → Drivers → Manage; driver Home
requirements.dataSource: Current driver account and branch, stored dispatch preference, active order assignments and the staff privilege registry.
requirements.securityControl: Staff management privilege, branch scope, password re-verification, active accounts and branches, audit reason, and existing field-operation release and assignment safeguards.
negativeTests: Another branch and a non-manager cannot change this preference.
Active deliveries block changing the driver to unavailable.
requirements.reason: Local backend coverage passed, including the driver toggle, and authenticated Chromium exercised the directory form at desktop and phone widths.
requirements.testResult: PASS: local service, type checks and authenticated browser actions with inline password re-verification.
requirements.outstandingWork: Repeat authenticated checks after hosted deployment.

gates.description: Approved active drivers start available without modifying existing choices.
Staff can change an active driver's availability from the directory and existing dispatch safeguards still hold.
